title: Human-AI interaction
summary:
Human-AI interaction is a field of study examining how people interact with artificial intelligence systems. Unlike the traditionally hierarchical human-computer interaction, where a human directed a machine, human-AI interaction has become more interdependent as AI generates its own insights. Human-AI interaction has a strong influence on the world as AI changes how people behave and make sense of the world.

Humans have a mental model of understanding AI's reasoning and motivation for its decision recommendations, and building a holistic and precise mental model of AI helps people create prompts to receive more valuable responses. However, these mental models are not complete because people can only gain more information about AI through their limited interaction with it. Human-AI collaboration occurs when the human and AI supervise the task on the same level and extent to achieve the same goal. AI may help human ability in analysis and decision-making through providing and weighing a volume of information, and learning to defer to the human decision when it recognizes its unreliability.

Companies have developed AI human companion systems specialized in emotional and social services, such as Replika, Chai, and Character.ai, separate from generative AI designed for general assistance like ChatGPT and Google Gemini. Although AI is capable of providing emotionally supportive responses that encourage people to intimately disclose their feelings, there are limitations in building human-AI social relationships with current AI structure. Google searches for the term "AI Girlfriend" increased over 2400% around 2023.

There have been reports of both men and women marrying AI models. In human-AI romantic relationships, people tend to follow typical trajectories and rituals in human-human romance including purchasing a wedding ring. The field explores usability, trust, and interpretability, with research aiming to design AI-driven interfaces that are transparent, explainable, and ethically responsible.
